SEC-109 justification re-derived from the current bytes, not inherited: both routes call authenticateApiRequest, resolve a venue (query param / body / getCurrentVenueContext), then canManageVenue(auth.supabase, user.id, venueId, 'manage_bookings'), and construct the service-role client only afterwards. PATCH and DELETE-by-id resolve scope from the row's own venue_id, so holding a foreign row id grants nothing.

executeServiceRoleJob was evaluated as the preferred remediation and REJECTED on three independent grounds (VENUE-D05 / CP-067): it throws org_not_found unless a verified organizations row exists and venue_profiles has no organization_id (the only link is the lazily provisioned settings.operational_org_id from ensureVenueOperationalContext), so it would 500 the editor for a venue that has not provisioned; its target block revalidates only eventId/tourId/saleId, so it could not re-assert venue scope even on success; and SERVICE_ROLE_MODULES has 33 ids with no venue availability or reservation surface, so adopting it means editing a security allowlist outside this grant. The client role also genuinely cannot do the work — migration 20260924120000 revokes client SELECT on both raw tables.
